CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

11. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 39

(1) The community participates in the provision of protection for Victims.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) takes the form of:

a. forming family partners at the village/sub-village level by the community,
b. forming women and child protection units within community organizations,
c. conducting socialization of women's and children's rights independently, d. providing first aid to victims, and e. reporting to the competent authority if violence against victims occurs in their environment. (3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by individuals, community social institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.

Article 4

The scope of this Regional Regulation includes efforts to prevent, serve and empower victims of violence in the Region.

Article 5

Forms of violence include:

a. physical violence,
b. psychological violence,
Cc. sexual violence,
d. neglect,
e. exploitation, and/or 1 other violence.

Article 13

Child victims of violence, in addition to receiving the rights as referred to in Article 12, shall also receive special rights, consisting of:

a. respect for survival, growth and development, basic services, equal protection, freedom from various stigmas, and/or obtaining freedom.

Article 8

Sexual violence as referred to in Article 5 letter c is caused by:

a. acts in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse,
Cc. forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, and/or
d. forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Article 30

(1) Legal services as referred to in Article 25 letter e in order to assist victims in undergoing the judicial process.

(2) Legal services as referred to in paragraph (1)

in the form of:

a. providing legal consultation which includes information regarding the rights of victims and the judicial process,
b. accompanying victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court hearings and assisting victims to fully explain the violence they experienced,
c. coordinating with fellow law enforcers, volunteer companions, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should.

Article 38

The duties and functions of FPKK as referred to in Article 37 paragraph (1) are:

a. coordinating and synchronizing prevention, services, and empowerment for women and child victims of violence,
b. maintaining and developing FPKK in the prevention, services, and empowerment of victims of violence in a networked manner and referral system,
Cc. conducting education on non-discrimination values towards women and children,
d. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the provision of protection for women and child victims of violence,
e. collecting, compiling, and presenting reports on violence victim data, and
f. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the provision of Protection for Women and Child Victims of Violence.

Article 9

Neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is caused by:

a. acts that result in the unfulfillment of a child's needs properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social carried out by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care,
b. acts of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of a child as appropriate carried out by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care,
Cc. acts of neglecting people within the scope of their household, even though according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person, and/or, d. acts that result in economic dependence by limiting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of regulations in the Region.

So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and child victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, thus institutional and regulatory support is needed to ensure its implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and child victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.
